review.subject: Neutral stacked dinnerware with seasonal table styling
review.summary: Three slow overhead and low-angle moves over stacked beige plates, ending on a seasonal place setting with a pine cone and candle where a script logo fades in. Warm soft light, no cuts beyond three scene changes; no text until the last 3s.

beats.note: Plate stack close from above, slow push-in.
Pull-out shows napkin and plate edges.
Tilt up to table with pine cone, candle, script logo fade-in.

shot_labels.note: Stacked plates from above, slow push-in
Pull-out reveals napkin and rim detail
Tilt up to place setting with pine cone

learn: Use three long 4s shots with one continuous gentle move each.
Switch the angle between shots (top-down, low angle, tilt up) rather than cutting often.
Hold a warm neutral grade across all shots.
Fade the logo in during the final 3s over the styled place setting.
Save text for the end; let the object be the hook.
